title: Single-stage joint diffusion of sky images and clear-sky index for ultra-short-term irradiance forecasting: what the frame-to-irradiance stage discards
title_zh: 单阶段联合扩散模型用于天空图像与晴朗天空指数的辐照度预测

paragraphs.en: 该研究提出了一种单阶段模型，通过联合扩散过程预测未来天空图像和晴朗天空指数，进而预测辐照度，提高超短期辐照度预测精度。 Sky-image irradiance forecasting is dominated by a two-stage design: a video-prediction model forecasts future sky frames, and a separately trained regressor maps those frames to irradiance. We propose a single-stage alternative that co-denoises the future sky-image and clear-sky-index sequences in one diffusion process, with an irradiance head that reads a denoised preview of the future sky rather than the noised diffusion state. The forecaster needs no regression stage and runs from sky images and deterministic covariates alone, with no measured irradiance at its input --- the situation at a site with a camera but no pyranometer. On 2023 SIRTA data the model reaches a pooled RMSE of $104.1$~W\,m$^{-2}$ and a skill score of $+0.34$ on the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) against smart persistence, higher than any of twelve baseline configurations, and retains that skill when retrained on 2021--2022. On the model's own generated frames, a separately trained regressor reaches $150.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$ against the joint head's $104.1$: roughly $46$~W\,m$^{-2}$ that joint training recovers and a cascade discards. Point accuracy is competitive but not best: a deterministic network that also reads measured irradiance attains $97.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$. The model's CRPS skill leads that network's in every sky-condition tertile, by $0.26$ to $0.30$.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究提出了一种单阶段模型，通过联合扩散过程预测未来天空图像和晴朗天空指数，进而预测辐照度，提高超短期辐照度预测精度。天空图像辐照度预测通常采用两阶段设计：视频预测模型预测未来天空帧，再由单独训练的回归器将这些帧映射为辐照度。 我们提出一种单阶段替代方案，在一个扩散过程中同时对未来天空图像序列和晴朗天空指数序列进行去噪，并设置一个辐照度输出头，它读取的是未来天空图像的去噪预览，而非加噪的扩散状态。 该预测器不需要回归阶段，仅依靠天空图像和确定性协变量运行，输入中不含实测辐照度——这正是有相机但无总辐射表的站点所面临的情况。 在2023年SIRTA数据上，该模型达到合并RMSE $104.1$~W\,m$^{-2}$，相对于智能持续基准在连续排序概率评分（CRPS）上取得 $+0.34$ 的技巧评分，高于十二种基线配置中的任何一种，并且在2021–2022年数据上重新训练后仍保持该技巧。 在模型自身生成的帧上，单独训练的回归器达到 $150.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$，而联合输出头为 $104.1$：这约 $46$~W\,m$^{-2}$ 的差距正是联合训练所能挽回、而级联方案所损失的部分。 其点精度具有竞争力但并非最优：一个同样读取实测辐照度的确定性网络达到了 $97.6$~W\,m$^{-2}$。 该模型的CRPS技巧在每一个天空状况三分位区间中都领先该网络，领先幅度为 $0.26$ 至 $0.30$。
